description: Find tracked city slugs, sample counts, observation dates, and source links. Filter by city name or slug, or request a page of up to 100 cities. An empty request returns the full catalog.

limit.description: Maximum cities per page. Defaults to 100 when a filter or offset is supplied.

offset.description: Number of matching cities to skip. Defaults to 0.

query.description: Case-insensitive city name or slug text, for example Austin or austin-tx.

name: list_covered_cities
title: List covered cities
